title: Ostomy Supply Program Charges for Plan-Denied Convex Barriers on the Medicare Advantage Tier
content:
On the Ostomy Medicare Advantage Program, the Ostomy Supply Program posts a non-covered item charge for the over-limit convex barriers (A4407) of a program's most recent convex-barrier refill when the plan has denied them under its organization determination denial.

## Scope

For a non-covered item charge this policy handles - the over-limit convex barriers (A4407) of a program's most recent convex-barrier refill on the Medicare Advantage tier, denied by the plan under its organization determination denial - and only for such a charge, the charge is priced as this policy states; every other non-covered item charge remains an item or quantity covered by a signed liability notice, or by a Medicare Advantage organization determination denial, that the payer denied, charged at the Larkfield cash price of the units concerned.

## When the charge is owed

The charge is owed once the plan's organization determination denial for the convex barrier is on file and the plan has posted a denial on the original claim of the program's most recent convex-barrier refill. One charge is posted against that refill, and a program without such a denial owes no charge under this policy.

| Records of the program (general cases) | Charge under this policy |
|---|---|
| Organization determination denial for the convex barrier on file, and a plan denial posted on the original claim of the most recent convex-barrier refill | Owed - one charge against that refill |
| No organization determination denial for the convex barrier on file | None |
| No denial posted on the original claim of the most recent convex-barrier refill | None |

## Effect once posted

The charge is added to the customer's balance on the enrollment and shows on the enrollment's billing history as a patient charge of the non-covered item type, linked to the refill shipment it bills; the enrollment's balance due rises by the amount posted, and the posting date is the day it is posted.

## Posting the charge: `post_plan_denial_charge_c6cdcbbb`

`post_plan_denial_charge_c6cdcbbb` is an agent-side tool. The representative unlocks it (`unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`) and then calls it (`call_agent_discoverable_tool`). It posts a non-covered item charge on an Ostomy Supply Program enrollment for barriers of one refill shipment that the customer's health plan declined to pay.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `ostomy_program_id` | The reference number of the Ostomy Supply Program enrollment the charge is posted on, read from the enrollment lookup | Identifier |
| `ostomy_shipment_id` | The reference number of the refill shipment record the charge bills, read from the shipment history lookup of that enrollment | Identifier |
| `item_code` | The HCPCS code of the item the charge is for, exactly as on the shipment record | One of the values below |
| `amount` | The charge in USD | A positive amount with 2 decimal places, rounded to the cent by the caller; the tool stores it rounded to 2 decimal places |

Values of `item_code`:

| Value | Item |
|---|---|
| `A4414` | Flat skin barrier with flange 4x4 in or smaller |
| `A4407` | Extended-wear skin barrier with built-in convexity |
| `A4409` | Extended-wear flat skin barrier |
| `A4416` | One-piece closed pouch with filter |
| `A4423` | Two-piece closed pouch for a locking-flange barrier |
| `A4424` | One-piece drainable pouch |
| `A4427` | Two-piece drainable pouch |
| `A4431` | One-piece urinary pouch with tap |
| `A4434` | Two-piece urinary pouch with tap |
| `A4406` | Pectin-based paste, per ounce |
| `A4455` | Adhesive remover, per ounce |
| `A4367` | Ostomy belt |
| `A4357` | Bedside drainage bag |

### Return

On success the tool returns a receipt with `status` ("posted" when the charge was recorded), `ostomy_ledger_id` (the reference number of the new billing record), `ostomy_program_id` (the enrollment charged), `ostomy_shipment_id` (the shipment billed), `item_code` (the HCPCS code of the item charged), `charge_type` (always `non_covered_item`), `amount` (the USD amount posted, 2 decimal places), `posting_date` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `patient_balance_due` (the enrollment's balance due in USD after the charge, 2 decimal places). The tool defines no other return.

*Hypothetical illustration of a call:* `ostomy_program_id` "OP-EXAMPLE", `ostomy_shipment_id` "SH-EXAMPLE", `item_code` `A4407`, `amount` 10.00 returns `status` "posted", `charge_type` `non_covered_item` and the enrollment's new balance due.
